name: The Lamplighter
description: the Wraith's chief carrier, a hunched thin old grey hooded wraith with no legs floating over the bridge, holding a very long wooden pole with a small yellow flame burning in a little cage at its tip, a shabby cloak, two small dim eyes under the hood, tired and dutiful

poses.stand: hovering hunched with the long pole held upright in both hands, the flame bright at its tip

dormant.action: folded small and still against the pole, head bowed, flame low

blind.action: the flame at the pole's tip nearly out, a thin wisp of smoke, the wraith peering around blindly with one hand held out

dead.action: gone: only the pole lying on the bridge with its cage empty and a thin curl of smoke

idle.action: sways slowly, the flame at the pole's tip flickering

rise.action: straightens up with the pole, the flame flaring bright

light.action: swings the pole down and touches the flame to the ground in front of him, a cyan rune flaring where it touches, then lifts it again

hurt.action: jerks back and clutches the pole, the flame guttering

blindClip.action: the flame at the pole's tip sputters and shrinks to a wisp, he turns his head from side to side in alarm

die.action: shuffles forward blindly, steps off the edge of the bridge, and is gone, the pole clattering down behind him
